question: 21|Number of countries have higher economic opportunity than the world
query: SELECT country_name, country_code FROM global_development_indicators WHERE econ_opportunity_index > (     SELECT AVG(econ_opportunity_index)      FROM global_development_indicators ) LIMIT 50
answer:
There are 21 countries that have higher economic opportunity than the world. These include:

- Central Europe and the Baltics (CEB)
- East Asia & Pacific (EAS)
- Europe & Central Asia (ECS)
- Euro area (EMU)
- European Union (EUU)

Each of these regions is listed multiple times, indicating they all have higher economic opportunities compared to the rest of the world.
